source_commit_basis: Explicit command-line value supplied by packager; smoke run folder is selected by its first seven characters.

tests.note: UTF-8-with-BOM log is read with BOM stripping. Only a log containing `Ran N tests` and an `OK` line verifies pass/count; the root-reported PowerShell NativeCommandError formatting around stderr is ignored. Otherwise count remains provisional and pass status unclaimed.
tests.log_formatting: Trailing whitespace and BOM removed from copied log only; original test output retained locally.

offline_sameas.mode: Saved snapshot re-extraction only; no network/API use, per included metadata.
offline_sameas.full_offline_run_outputs_note: Omitted to avoid duplicating the live smoke corpus.

search_pilot.excluded_content: Raw responses, secrets, and scripts are excluded.
